concept.title: A running club for an experienced runner
concept.shortdesc: As someone who runs about 25 miles a week, I need a running club that welcomes new members and does weekend long runs, so that I can train with others in a new city.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-016). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Situation: Moved city six months ago; wants a routine like he had before.
A good result: Clubs that take new members at his level, with run days, distances, cost and how to join.
How much it matters: Convenience: a miss is an inconvenience, so the bar is lower.

ul.li: I want to join a running club in Manchester — I'm in Ancoats, M4. I'm doing about 25 miles a week so not a beginner. Looking for something with weekend long runs.
